name: Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 8 years of continuous residence in Finland.
As of 17 December 2025: must not have relied on unemployment benefit or social assistance for longer than 3 months during the past 2 years; income must be legal and adequate.
As of 17 December 2025: applicants issued an alien's passport must present a valid national passport or equivalent document to verify identity to a stricter standard than before.

No disqualifying criminal offences; a negative decision triggers a 1-8 year waiting period before reapplying (reformed December 2025). Serious offences including terrorism, treason, or high treason (6+ years' imprisonment) can bar citizenship or cause its loss.

5 years of continuous residence (instead of 8) if the applicant meets the required Finnish/Swedish language proficiency (via YKI certificate, Civil Service Language Proficiency Certificate, matriculation exam, or a higher-education degree completed in Finnish/Swedish), plus the same financial-resources, identity, and conduct conditions as the standard route.

requirement_groups.name: Nordic citizens / spouses of Finnish diplomats

requirements.blocker_text: 2 years of residence for citizens of other Nordic countries (Denmark, Iceland, Norway, Sweden), or for spouses of Finnish diplomats.

evidence_required.document: Proof of residence period matching the applicable category
Valid national passport or identity document
Proof of sufficient/legal income, no extended reliance on social assistance

sources.title: Maahanmuuttovirasto -- FAQ: Finnish Citizenship: 8-year standard / 5-year language-reduced / 2-year Nordic-and-diplomat-spouse residence requirements, language proficiency standards, dual citizenship allowed

Maahanmuuttovirasto -- Amendments to the Citizenship Act, effective 17 December 2025: sufficient financial resources requirement, stricter identity establishment, strengthened integrity/national-security conduct requirements, 1-8 year waiting periods after negative decisions

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Finland). MAJOR REFORM, effective 17 December 2025 (already in force): added the financial-resources, stricter-identity, and strengthened-integrity conditions modeled here as new hard requirements on top of the pre-existing residence-duration framework, which itself was NOT changed by this reform. A further reform -- introduction of a citizenship TEST -- is scheduled to take effect 1 January 2027, i.e. AFTER this build's verification date; NOT modeled as a current requirement, flagged here as a near-future change for a later revisit. dual_citizenship_allowed modeled true per the FAQ page's explicit statement that acquiring another nationality does not cause automatic loss of Finnish citizenship.
